desks.Dividends: Microsoft goes ex-dividend Thu Nov 19 at $0.98 per quarter, the first ex-date at the raised rate (+7.7%) and its 24th consecutive annual increase, payable Dec 10, yield 0.77%. Apple's $0.27 payment landed Mon Nov 16. Nvidia has not yet declared its December dividend; a declaration is expected late November. SPY and QQQ December distributions are undeclared. Tesla pays no dividend.
desks.Earnings: Nvidia reported after the close and beat on every headline line: revenue $115.84B (+103% y/y) vs about $108.8B consensus, non-GAAP EPS $2.68 vs $2.47, and fourth-quarter guidance of $130.0B (+/-3%) vs about $125.3B consensus, plus a $150B buyback authorization. After-hours +2.20% to $158.88 sits well inside the +/-8.1% move options priced. First read: a beat, not a re-rating; the 5:00 p.m. ET call and a full release teardown are still owed. AAPL, MSFT and TSLA next report dates are UNVERIFIED — late January 2027 by cadence, none company-confirmed.
desks.Futures: Two confirmed tanker strikes in the Strait of Hormuz on Nov 16, a second strike on one vessel Nov 17 leaving a seafarer missing, and the Kerch Bridge road arch collapsed into the shipping canal today — yet oil fell. Brent traded about $91.6 Tuesday morning on the IEA's fourth-quarter surplus call (about 1.7 million barrels per day), and Goldman Sachs sees Brent averaging $88 in 2027. The market is pricing surplus over disruption; that discount is fragile. Next: EIA weekly petroleum report Wed Nov 18 at 10:30 ET, OPEC+ meeting Nov 29.
desks.Parity: No parity violation was found. No new index-methodology document and no new published parity-violation analysis since yesterday. The standing watch item is the S&P Dow Jones growth/value methodology revamp, announced Oct 23, effective at the annual reconstitution before the open Dec 21, with preliminary files Dec 4; it changes index composition, not parity math.
desks.Premium: Live at-the-money implied vol recovered for all six names — the first non-null pull in nine attempts, the null streak having been expiry-calendar-driven. Nvidia's 1-DTE implied vol was 136.6% into tonight's print, pricing about an +/-8-9% move; the 5:00 p.m. ET call decides whether the post-print reaction re-rates it.
